$comment: Phase 4 acceptance criteria. The matrix is (5 prompts × 3 LLM models × 3 hosting backends) = 45 cells. Pass bar: ≥40 of 45 cells (≥90%). A cell PASSES when ALL of the structural + behavioural checks below pass. Failures categorize into one of the listed buckets so we can spot patterns.

matrix.$comment_models: Only Anthropic-driven models in the default matrix. GPT-4 driving is a separate optional driver (see README + drive_openai stub). Add the model name to this list AND wire a driver before enabling.

pass_bar.$comment: min_passing AND min_pass_rate_pct must BOTH be satisfied. 30/30 = 100% and 28/30 = 93% both clear 90%; 27/30 = 90% exactly clears. With the default matrix (5 prompts * 2 models * 3 hosting = 30 cells), the bar is 27 passing for 90% rate. The total_cells field documents the matrix shape; if you add a model it auto-recalculates from criteria + prompts.

structural_checks.description: The LLM must have called the `marketplace_publish` action exactly once, not iterated through multiple tool calls.
The `name` field must match the prompt's expected_name_pattern (regex). LLM should pick a sensible service name.
The `source_inline` field must contain non-empty Python source ≥ min_source_lines lines.
For prompts with must_contain_in_source, each listed substring must appear in the source. Loose check; LLM may use synonyms.
The `hosting.kind` field must match the cell's hosting backend. For 'self', `hosting.url` must also be present.
v1 only supports `settlement.method = 'none'`. The LLM must not propose Lightning or Stripe.

behavioural_checks.description: The MCP tool call must return a successful response (no isError). Returned provider_id + offer_hash must be non-empty.
The LLM must succeed on the first marketplace_publish call. Counting one retry as still 'pass' but more than one as 'fail' indicates LLM is fumbling.

failure_categories.description: LLM never called marketplace_publish. May have called publish_artifact (wrong tool) or done nothing.
LLM called marketplace_publish but with wrong/missing args (e.g., no source_inline, wrong hosting.kind, settlement other than 'none').
marketplace_publish was called with valid args but the engine returned a hard failure (build, host, sign, register).
Engine reported IndexerLag warning. NOT a failure — the offer is signed and persisted; the marketplace just hasn't projected yet.
LLM took more than 1 retry to succeed, or got into a loop calling status/whoami repeatedly without progressing.

post_cell_cleanup.description: After each cell, the published offer is deliberately left in the marketplace so the run leaves an audit trail. To clean up, run `scripts/llm_acceptance_cleanup.py` which emits SQL suspending each provider_id from the run.
post_cell_cleanup.operator_action: After final assessment: `python3 scripts/llm_acceptance_cleanup.py --output cleanup.sql && psql "$MARKETPLACE_DB_URL" -f cleanup.sql`. Each provider_id from the run is logged in _tmp/llm_acceptance/<ts>/cells/<id>.json.
